name: google-research/harness2
title: Google's Harness2 recursively improves agent harnesses without weight updates
summary: Harness2 from Google Research proposes, tests and combines changes to an agent's prompts, tools and workflows, then stores lessons to guide later changes; the paper reports gains of up to 11.5% on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5% on JobBench and 11.8% on Legal Agent Bench with GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash. Code is on GitHub.
